_comment: TODO: fill in real component names once the screen's layout has been designed in the Nextion/SmartElex Editor. Left EMPTY on purpose - an empty map means the HMI task runs but sends nothing, rather than guessing at component names that don't exist on your actual screen. Only include the sensors you actually gave a text box to on the screen - most screens won't have room for all 26.
_example: "SO2_out": "t0" would mean: whenever SO2_out updates, write its value into the component named 't0' in your Nextion project. Component names are visible in the Nextion Editor's own component list/tree for whatever page you designed - they are NOT something this codebase can know or guess.
